finding.expected_contract: A synchronous restore adoption may complete processor state changes while an editor listener destroys the GUI; no callback may access the editor or component-owned callback state after destruction.
finding.mechanism: A host restore installs sound and pauses before metadata handoff. An A/B switch changes the live sound. Message-thread adoption reinstalls the restore, synchronously notifying parameters. A listener destroys the editor while the timer or preset-name callback is still active.

paths.baseline_asan: heap-use-after-free at the post-call undoButton access (PluginEditor.cpp:1674 on baseline)
paths.corrected_guard: Stack-owned Component::SafePointer; return before the following control update when nulled.

paths.baseline_asan: heap-use-after-free after adoption resumes (PluginEditor.cpp:2206 on baseline)
paths.corrected_guard: The component-owned onClick closure copies its SafePointer to its stack; showPresetMenu also keeps a stack-owned SafePointer across adoption.

finding.user_impact_evidence: Deterministic source-level memory-safety defect. No supported-host incidence or field crash rate is claimed.

regression.fixture: A real editor and callback, off-thread restore held after sound installation, intervening A/B sound change, synchronous parameter listener, live and editor-destruction controls.
controls: The restored and outgoing sessions differ; A/B changes the live sound before adoption.
The listener verifies message-thread delivery and synchronous notification.
The live-editor case retains the editor and completes the same processor transition.
The destruction case destroys exactly once; processor metadata and restored parameter values still complete.
regression.headless_limit: The preset callback adds in-memory JUCE display-placement metadata only; no peer, native window, visual, host or accessibility acceptance is claimed.

sanitizer.configuration: GCC 14, RelWithDebInfo (-O2 -g), ASan+UBSan, leak detection enabled; existing JUCE 9.0.4 dependency and state-test target.

full_state_suite.classification: Filesystem exhaustion while creating preset-copy and synthetic write-failure fixtures. No sanitizer memory-safety diagnostic was reported by these eleven failures; this is not a passing full suite.
